about_the_game:
The world is not fair to you. The things you need are so simple, and yet malicious forces and careless people tear you down. The only thing that keeps those forces propped up is FEAR.

FEAR keeps you from taking that bold step, from leaping off that precipice into the great beyond. FEAR is the only reason you aren't PERFECT. Thankfully, the fair and righteous RRG CORPORATION deployed the world's foremost engineers and scientists onto this issue, and they solved it.

Introducing the comprehensive solution to FEAR, Amygdalum, a lifesaving breakthrough that intellectuals around the world have been raving about as the end of FEAR.

Features:

  • Top-down gameplay centered around survival using your flashlight and interactive environmental tools to dispatch several unique enemy types

  • Collectable secret items hidden throughout 7 handcrafted levels

  • Discoverable hidden messages and multiple endings exposing the secrets of RRG

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6300U or greater
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 2 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Amygdalum will pit you against the forces of FEAR. Face unique threats and survive the night in this short top-down thriller. Explore the darkness to uncover secrets if you dare. If you are worthy you can escape FEAR forever, no matter the consequences. . . .
